mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 51 degrees near the Verona Area High School, with a waxing gibbous moon still visible.

The City of Verona is currently hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Also, remember that the City offers a 30 dollar rebate for residents who install rain barrels to help manage stormwater, which remains a focus following recent utility rate adjustments to ensure our sewer and stormwater systems stay self-supporting.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga sessions at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia or the Quizmasters event at Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding recent activity, on Friday, August 15, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive in her vehicle.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the decadent Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
